items.brief: Apple and Meta reject OKX-ICE tokenized stock plans; crypto firms remain
items.why: Shows major tech issuers opting out of tokenized equity plans, leaving crypto firms.

items.brief: Crypto firms expand into stablecoins and payments but earnings show volatility
items.why: Highlights earnings volatility for tokenization-adjacent crypto business models.

items.brief: Amundi tokenizes equity index fund share class on Ethereum
items.why: Shows a large asset manager using blockchain for tokenized fund shares.

items.brief: Amundi adds tokenized share class to €22.8bn European equity index fund
items.why: First large European equity index fund with tokenized share class on Ethereum.
